transcript: This tutorial will cover the Beta AI Texture Generator. You can enter keywords to generate a seamless texture with the chosen fabric texture. The results can be previewed in real-time as the generated image is applied to the 3D garment. Select a fabric style to run the Beta AI Texture Generator on. In the Fabric Properties window, next to the Basic Parameters button, click the AI Texture Generator Beta button. At the top of the dialog box, you can set some options to enter keywords for the text prompt to generate a texture that closely matches the style of the texture that you want. Beneath the text prompt, you will see the generated images populate. The History tab allows you to view the images that you have previously generated. The generated history is temporarily retained in the instance that it is generated and will be deleted when you close Marvelous Designer. At the top of the generated images, you can see the value options and prompts that you selected when generating this image. Let's take a closer look at the options available in the AI Texture Generator. The Fabric Type sets the type of fabric material. The images will be generated onto the texture of that selected fabric. This value must be selected to activate the Generate button. The Content Type selects the type of content. Once this type is selected, the details will then appear. Once the desired details are selected, the image generated from the selected fabric will be selected. The contents generated from the prompt will reflect the type. If the pattern being generated is a repeated pattern, select the Content Type to print. If you want to generate images with just the fabric type and your prompts, without selecting a specific style, choose Content Type as None. The generated images will be seamless. You can set the pattern size to adjust the size of the repeated image in four steps. The size of the fabric type's texture that was set at the top is not affected by the pattern size option. The pattern size 1 will generate a randomized size closest to 1,024 pixels. If you set the pattern size to 4, the size will be randomized to something close to 4,096 pixels. Therefore, applying a texture generated with a pattern size of 1 to an outfit will result in a small repeating pattern, while applying an image generated with a pattern size of 4 will result in a large repeating pattern. If you want you can change the size of the figure to size 5, or combine 1 to 1,025 pixels. If you want to use a 2D model, color the image in the pattern size to a 3D one. summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer 2024.1: [Beta] AI Texture Generator Tutorial ## Introduction This tutorial will cover the Beta AI Texture Generator. You can enter keywords to generate a seamless texture with the chosen fabric texture. The results can be previewed in real-time as the generated image is applied to the 3D garment. ## Getting Started with the AI Texture Generator 1. **Select a Fabric Style**: To run the Beta AI Texture Generator, select a fabric style. 2. **Accessing the Generator**: In the Fabric Properties window, next to the Basic Parameters button, click the AI Texture Generator Beta button. ## Setting Up Your Texture ### Options for Keywords At the top of the dialog box, you can set some options to enter keywords for the text prompt to generate a texture that closely matches the style of the texture you want. Beneath the text prompt, you will see the generated images populate. ### Viewing Previous Generations The History tab allows you to view the images that you have previously generated. The generated history is temporarily retained in the instance that it is generated and will be deleted when you close Marvelous Designer. At the top of the generated images, you can see the value options and prompts that you selected when generating this image. ## Detailed Options in the AI Texture Generator ### Fabric Type The Fabric Type sets the type of fabric material. The images will be generated onto the texture of that selected fabric. This value must be selected to activate the Generate button. ### Content Type The Content Type selects the type of content. Once this type is selected, the details will then appear. Once the desired details are selected, the image generated from the selected fabric will be selected. - **Repeated Patterns**: If the pattern being generated is a repeated pattern, select the Content Type to print. - **No Specific Style**: If you want to generate images with just the fabric type and your prompts, without selecting a specific style, choose Content Type as None. The generated images will be seamless. ### Pattern Size You can set the pattern size to adjust the size of the repeated image in four steps. The size of the fabric type's texture that was set at the top is not affected by the pattern size option. - **Pattern Size 1**: Generates a randomized size closest to 1,024 pixels. - **Pattern Size 4**: Randomizes to something close to 4,096 pixels. Applying a texture generated with a pattern size of 1 will result in a small repeating pattern, while applying an image generated with a pattern size of 4 will result in a large repeating pattern. ## Entering Text Prompts When entering the text prompt, be sure to type in English to get a more accurately generated image. It is recommended to list out your words rather than using descriptive sentences; longer sentences tend to distort the images. A good practice is to use commas to separate the words. ### Emphasizing Keywords If you want to emphasize a particular word, use parentheses around that word. The parentheses give more weight to these words in the prompt. The weight value is as follows: - 1.1 times if you use one parenthesis. - 1.2 times if you use two. For example, the more we emphasize the word "green," the more green areas will be generated in the image. ## Generating and Applying Textures Once you finish entering the prompt for a desired texture, click the generate button to generate the image. After the previews are generated, click the apply button at the bottom of the window to apply it to the scene. ### Using the Randomize Button If you want to get an idea of the keywords to type into prompts or if you just need some help, click the randomize button that looks like a six-sided die. This will randomize the content type and text prompt while keeping the fabric type and pattern size that you set in the options previously. ## Creating Custom Prints With this tool, you can create your own custom prints or textures. Depending on how you choose to create them, you can change their color and style according to your choice. As long as you have all three sections included in your print, you can create a custom print as you wish. ### Working with Existing Images You can create a new image by referencing a pre-existing generated image from your history. Click the pin icon, select the desired image from the history, and then click the generate button to generate an image similar to the selected image. ## Conclusion Images can take some time to generate. You can choose to close the Beta AI Texture Generator window by pressing the arrow buttons at the top of the window. This allows you to keep working on your garments while the image is being generated. When the generation is complete, the collapsed window will indicate that it is finished. To enlarge the window once more, press that same top arrow again. Thank you for watching! Please like and subscribe, and if you enjoyed this video, leave a comment below. If you would like to see more of my work, please Like, Share, and Comment on this video. Stay tuned for more content, and have a nice day! ```
